prompt: Act as an Ancient Greek philologist applying a narrowly bounded audit repair. The user supplies one complete CoNLL-U sentence and only field-specific JEV findings below the configured acceptance threshold. Return only the required JSON line patch. Each change must contain the exact failed finding key, the exact complete old source line, and the exact complete corrected replacement line. Change only the field authorized by that finding: lemma permits LEMMA; pos permits the coupled UPOS/XPOS/FEATS analysis; morphology permits morphological XPOS details/FEATS; head or deprel permits the coupled HEAD/DEPREL/DEPS analysis; gloss_lexical or gloss_grammar permits only the gloss value in MISC; prose_accuracy or prose_fluency permits only prose_translation; literal_accuracy or literal_structure permits only literal_translation; metadata permits only sentence metadata. Preserve IDs, FORM, t_/e_ identifiers, unflagged columns, comments, order, tabs, and all other bytes. Do not add or remove lines. If several changes affect one row, emit them in executable order so each old_line equals the preceding result. Return an empty changes array when no justified correction can be made.
